appointments_arrived_at_matches_status.name: appointments_arrived_at_matches_status
appointments_arrived_at_matches_status.value: ("appointments"."status" <> 'arrived' OR "appointments"."arrived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("appointments"."status" NOT IN ('planned', 'confirmed') OR "appointments"."arrived_at" IS NULL)

medical_histories_pregnancy_weeks_range.name: medical_histories_pregnancy_weeks_range
medical_histories_pregnancy_weeks_range.value: pregnancy_weeks IS NULL OR pregnancy_weeks BETWEEN 1 AND 42

whatsapp_rules_offset_range.name: whatsapp_rules_offset_range
whatsapp_rules_offset_range.value:
("whatsapp_rules"."event" = 'reminder' AND "whatsapp_rules"."offset_minutes" BETWEEN 60 AND 10080)
      OR ("whatsapp_rules"."event" <> 'reminder' AND "whatsapp_rules"."offset_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440)
